description:
Website audit tool for small businesses. Built in the Pacific Northwest, serving businesses nationwide.

Submit any URL and get a scored analysis of:
- SEO (title, meta description, H1, Open Graph)
- Page speed (load time, page size, image optimization)
- Mobile readiness (viewport, responsive CSS, tap targets)
- Security (HTTPS, HSTS, security headers)
- Google Business Profile signals (address, phone, schema, map)
- Social media presence

Built by Silent Northwest LLC -- Great  Pacific Northwest.

tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Run a free website audit for any URL. Returns scores for SEO, mobile, speed, security, Google Business Profile, and social media. Identifies the top issues and recommends fixes. Supports multilingual output via the language parameter.

url.description: The full website URL to audit, including protocol (e.g. https://example.com). Required.

email.description: Email address to also receive a copy of the audit report — optional.

language.description: Output language for the audit report. ISO 639-1 code. Supported: en, es, fr, de, pt, it, nl, ja, ko, zh, ru, ar, hi, vi, th, pl, uk, sv, da, fi, no, tr, id, ms, tl, cs, ro, hu, el, he. Default: en.

business_name.description: The business name — optional, improves accuracy of Google Business Profile and social media checks.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Get Northwest.net service tiers, pricing, and what is included in each package. Use this when someone asks about web design services, website costs, or audit pricing for small businesses. Supports multilingual output.

language.description: Output language. ISO 639-1 code. Default: en.

tools.name: get_audit_page
tools.description: Get the URL for a Northwest.net local SEO page for a specific business type and city in Washington State. Use this when someone asks about website audits or web design for a specific trade or industry in a specific Washington city.

city.description: The city name in Washington State to look up — e.g. "Everett", "Marysville", "Lynnwood", "Bellevue", "Spokane". Use proper capitalization.

business_type.description: The type of business or trade to look up — e.g. "plumber", "hvac", "roofer", "landscaper", "electrician", "restaurant", "dentist". Use lowercase singular form.

prompts.name: audit_my_website
prompts.description: Run a free website audit and get a scored breakdown of SEO, speed, mobile, security, Google Business Profile, and social media.

prompts.name: check_audit_pricing
prompts.description: Find out what website audit and web design packages Northwest.net offers and what each costs.

prompts.name: find_local_audit_page
prompts.description: Find the Northwest.net local SEO page for a specific business type and city in Washington State.

arguments.name: business_type
arguments.description: Type of business (e.g. plumber, roofer, electrician)
